name: Advanced Trap Training (Ex)
body:
Prerequisites: Learn Ranger Trap feat or ranger trap class feature.

Benefit:The rogue chooses one ranger trap she does not already know how to create when she gains this talent. She learns how to create this ranger trap, in addition to those she already knows. The total number of ranger traps the roguemay create in a day increases by 1.

This talent may be selected multiple times. Every time this talent is gained, the rogue learns another ranger trap and increases her total traps per day by 1.
